# Casino Application Setup Instructions

- [x] Create copilot-instructions.md file in .github directory
- [ ] Scaffold the Project Structure
- [ ] Create Backend Configuration (Express, SQLite)
- [ ] Create Frontend (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
- [ ] Create Admin Panel
- [ ] Install Dependencies
- [ ] Test and Run Application

## Project Overview
Advanced casino application with:
- User authentication (login/register)
- Multiple casino games (Blackjack, Roulette, Slots)
- Betting system with balance management
- Admin panel for user and game management
- SQLite database for persistence
- Express.js backend
- Responsive HTML/CSS/JS frontend
